_doc: CODE-AGENTS-1 (owner directive 2026-11-12): the adapter registry of code agents that edit this codebase, how each is reached, what it costs and which model family it belongs to. Routing by cost and the disjoint-family ensemble rule (from the QNFO fleet's review gate, platform/cloudflare-reference/scripts/review_gate.py) are code in foundation/agents.py. Every adapter has a test that invokes it (tests/foundation/test_agents.py) and a live probe (`python3 -m foundation agents --probe`). Prices are USD per million tokens as recorded in the QNFO review gate on 2026-11-04 or the provider's list price; unknown ones are null and rank last.

adapters.note: FREE-LLM-1: GitHub Models over the workflow's built-in GITHUB_TOKEN (permissions: models: read); no key to mint, rate-limited free tier, ranks first because it costs 0; free tier caps a request near 8k tokens in and 4k out, so the prompt is trimmed to max_prompt_chars
adapters.retired_why: GitHub Models was retired on 2026-07-30 (github.blog changelog); the endpoint answers HTTP 200 text/plain OK to every call

routing.author_order: cheapest known price first, unknown price after, session route last

ensemble.when: the change touches auth, routes, cache, migrations or workflows
